snippet.title: Tai Pan - (1979) - TRS-80 - WIN!
snippet.description:
➨ Follow me on Instagram: http://www.instagram.com/vghchannel/ 
➨ Donate: http://paypal.me/vghchannel
 ⇩  Click "SHOW MORE" for details and review

Art Canfil © 1979 
[Computer] TRS-80 Model 1, Level II
Emulator:  MAME 0.215
Rating: 6/10

One of the more fun strategy/sim games I played for all of 1979.  I made bundles of money in the Saigon trade wars.  ;-)  Tai Pan had the right mix of atmosphere, strategy, gameplay but most importantly -- no overwhelm of choices.  

The menu system is great, always presenting you with your next move.  The idea is trading to make money.  Buy goods in one port, sail to another and sell them.  Classic trade wars style game.  A few really cool curveballs are sent your way, including getting attacked at sea by fearsome Armadas, or individuals, and having to fight your way to port.

The secret of really winning big, however, is that in the home Harbor you can store things in a warehouse.  Buy as MUCH as you possibly can when something is on sale and store it in the warehouse.  You only have limited ship supply, but warehouse is unlimited.  Then sale off, and return, and sell ALL the inventory from warehouse at a profit.  With this method I retired with TRILLIONS of dollars and could just keep on going.  Fun stuff!!
